description_en: Use when the user wants to systematically learn, research or unpack an unfamiliar topic. Turns a topic into a ten-step verifiable evidence chain: fact-check, expert panel, contradiction adjudication, credibility scoring, resource roadmap, five-level ladder, 20-hour sprint, quiz, Feynman explanation, cheat sheet — delivered as a mobile-readable, printable single-file handbook. Supports single-step invocation and graceful degradation. Triggers: 'ten-step learn X', 'ten-step research X', 'ten-step deconstruct X'. Not for single-concept lookups or procedure queries. Skill id: ten-step-learning.
